title: Unfair contract terms made illegal with penalties; broader small business coverage
summary: From 9 November 2023 proposing, using or relying on unfair terms in standard form consumer or small business contracts became prohibited with civil penalties, and the small business threshold was widened; general CCA/ACL penalties were raised from 10 November 2022.

instruments.title: Treasury Laws Amendment (More Competition, Better Prices) Act 2022

commenced.what: Schedule 1: higher maximum penalties for competition and consumer law contraventions
Schedule 2: unfair contract terms prohibition and penalties

direction_rationale: Penalties strengthen deterrence of one-sided contract terms imposed on small businesses, plausibly improving their ability to compete.

assessment.summary: Using unfair terms in standard form contracts now attracts civil penalties, and more small businesses are covered. Stronger deterrence of one-sided terms; firms bear a one-off cost of reviewing their contracts.

marks.reason: Penalties deter larger firms from imposing one-sided terms on consumers and small businesses.
